verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer supports persistent, manually written custom rules and comment exclusions. These capture team conventions and apply them to all future reviews. Nothing shows the reviewer building memory on its own or learning from past review decisions. missing for 10: automatic learning of conventions from the codebase or past reviews, memory of prior review decisions (accepted/rejected comments) feeding future PRs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer builds a persistent memory of my team's conventions and past review decisions and applies it to future PRs

citations.quote: Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.
Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
